create.name: Anandra George
create.bio:
Anandra George is a musician and teacher of mantra and nāda yoga, the yoga of sound, and the founder of Heart of Sound. She first travelled to India in 1997 and has studied there for long periods since, learning Hindustani classical singing within a family line of musicians and working closely on the precise pronunciation of Sanskrit. She says her teachers encouraged her to pass these practices on, and she has been teaching for more than twenty-five years.

Her approach treats sound as a contemplative practice for the whole body: Sanskrit syllables felt in the mouth and chest, rāga-based singing as meditation, kīrtan, and gentle postures that support the voice, framed by a non-dual Tantric outlook and a good deal of humour. Through Heart of Sound she runs a 200-hour online teacher training in mantra and sound, a nāda yoga course taught with her Indian music teachers, and a seven-part course on Sanskrit sounds, along with chant retreats in Australia, Europe and India and free online chanting gatherings. She divides her time between India and the island of Kaua'i in Hawai'i, where she records live sound sessions for her YouTube channel.

courses.title: Sound Healing Yoga Training Online (200-hour)
courses.description: Heart of Sound's 200-hour online teacher training in nāda yoga and Sanskrit mantra, which can be combined with in-person retreats. Trainees learn vocal toning, harmonium, kīrtan leading and how to guide others in sound-based practice.

courses.title: Nāda Yoga Training
courses.description: An online course in meditative Indian classical singing, taught by Anandra with her music teacher and his senior student. It covers rāgas and voice practice from the beginning and offers a route into rāga-based kīrtan for chant leaders.

courses.title: Sacred Sanskrit Sounds
courses.description: A seven-module online course on the fifty sounds of Sanskrit and where each is placed in the mouth and body. It helps people who already chant mantras pronounce them precisely and feel them more fully.
courses.price: $497 USD (with certification $697 USD; Sanskrit Mantra 101 $199 USD)

courses.title: Australia 7-Day Chant Retreat & Training
courses.description: A residential week of mantra, classical vocal meditation, kīrtan and gentle yoga with Anandra at a retreat centre in the Sydney hinterland. It can be taken as a retreat alone or as part of the teacher training.

free_resources.title: Free Sound & Mantra Training Gifts
free_resources.description: A page of free Heart of Sound material, including a regular free online chant gathering led by Anandra and her graduates, and short recorded classes on mantra and chant leading.
